text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While helping set up for the mini-live 
performance to be held at the Tracen 
Academy Open Campus――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over in the corner of the venue, Win 
Variation was dancing away.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
All right, both my face and body feel way 
more relaxed now.
choice_data_list:
Is that ballet? Are you dancing a solo 
part?

Is that ballet? Are you dancing a solo 
part?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's just a warm-up. It's the 
routine I used to do... back when I did 
ballet.
choice_data_list:
You're being awfully thorough, even though 
today is just preparation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
During the blocking rehearsal, they'll 
adjust the lighting. I learned in ballet 
that how your expressions come across 
totally depends on the lighting.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how to present yourself 
beautifully―― that's an essential quality 
for a protagonist, too...!

text_block_list.name: Staff Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Tracen Ondo! All 
participating Umamusume, please head to 
the stage!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, in that case... I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blocking for the "Tracen Ondo" has begun. 
A large number of performers are featured 
in this song.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, amid all that—delightfully varied 
expressions, and sharp, exquisite dancing 
right down to the fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without realizing it, my eyes kept 
tracking Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you were watching? How was it? Was 
there anything that caught your eye?
choice_data_list: Your lively dance totally drew me in!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... R-Really...? I-I'm so happy... 
hehe.
choice_data_list:
Without a doubt, you were the star of the 
show!

Without a doubt, you were the star of the 
show!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
! …………The leading lady…… ……If only I could 
become that……

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Still... the star of the show should be 
even more――

text_block_list.name: Staff Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Next is Orfevre's solo! You're up!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Are we finished, then?

text_block_list.name: Staff Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, y-yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's blocking check lasted merely a 
moment. All she did was stand in the 
center――
choice_data_list:
S-She really marches to the beat of her 
own drum, doesn't she? Orfevre, that is.

S-She really marches to the beat of her 
own drum, doesn't she? Orfevre, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's blocking check lasted merely a 
moment. All she did was stand in the 
center――
choice_data_list:
S-She really marches to the beat of her 
own drum, doesn't she? Orfevre, that is.

S-She really marches to the beat of her 
own drum, doesn't she? Orfevre, that is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's totally absurd! There's no way we 
can adjust anything in such a short amount 
of time!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Though... maybe I don't even need to make 
any adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That guy is... the star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Because she can radiate light on her own――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To her, having everything go exactly her 
way is just basic common sense! Seriously, 
give me a break already!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Freely, unconditionally, commanding 
every single pair of eyes—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's what you'd call the sheer 
charisma of a true leading lady...
